posts.cooked:
Hi Team,
I noticed a discrepancy in my Week 10 assignment score. My grades page shows 100, but the main dashboard displays 50. I have attached the screenshots for reference. It would be helpful if someone could look into this. Thank you!
@sayan @Narayanan.POD

image1096×112 14 KB

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Dashboard marks are average of GA and GrPA with half weightage to each. Did you do grpa for week 10 ?

posts.name: Sahaya Shabani Justin
posts.cooked: No, I didnt attempt the GRPA for Week 10. However, for all the previous weeks, the assignment marks and GRPA marks are shown separately on the dashboard. I am not sure why Week 10 is displayed differently.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: It is same for all weeks and all courses. Grpa marks is shown separately yes, but assignment mark is average of the two.
